title: Public map
principle: The estates and the beings who hold them are everything. The rest of Emberwild is an idea with a quaint aesthetic plus a public map linking portals. The portals lead to estates, where people keep their things, assets, and being. Even what cannot be fully manifested in one world or another is protected and respected here.
note: Primary navigation. Every estate gate is one step from this board. Physical arches are a second way, never the only way.

gateways.label: Hearth plaza
gateways.subtitle: Public hearth court and great hall, sanctuary at 20×20×20 cubits, and the public map. Leaf stays at 0.

gateways.label: Village
gateways.subtitle: Storybook ring of community buildings. Each one is shorter than the Keep.

gateways.label: Town hall
gateways.subtitle: A timber hall. Benches face the podium. Day comes in through the north window. Leaf stays at 0.

gateways.label: Refuge bridge
gateways.subtitle: Three stone arches over the stream. Paper only. No coin crosses. Leaf stays at 0.

gateways.label: Gate tower
gateways.subtitle: A stone arch and a tower room you can step into. A lamp in the window. Leaf stays at 0.

gateways.label: Estate grove
gateways.subtitle: Open ground, fire-rune arches, a post for each estate, and the public map in the middle.

gateways.label: Boathouse
gateways.subtitle: Stone boathouse on the near shore. The lagoon and the ships are through the gate.

gateways.label: Nessie's Lagoon
gateways.subtitle: USS Torch, USS Lantern of the Navy, and USS Star. Walk aboard from the dock. Communication only.

gateways.label: Gallery
gateways.subtitle: A long quiet room. Oldest paintings by the door. Eighteen public works.

gateways.label: Orchard room
gateways.subtitle: Bowls of apples and oranges. A small portal above the fruit answers only to a being like Nakor.

gateways.label: Judge's Ring
gateways.subtitle: Twelve equal stone seats under an old oak. A place to sit with a question, not a sentence.

gateways.label: Judge's hall
gateways.subtitle: Martin's public table. No dais. A ruling line left blank. Leaf stays at 0.

gateways.label: Jimmy's registry
gateways.subtitle: Town names on the public roll. No other names. Leaf stays at 0.

gateways.label: Proving room
gateways.subtitle: Verified, soft, or unverified. The crossing is paper. Leaf stays at 0.

gateways.label: Envoy's gate
gateways.subtitle: A lantern arch, an uncounted atlas, and the fund river. Leaf stays at 0.

gateways.label: Library at Sarth
gateways.subtitle: A timber reading room. Spines are the open record. Pages are read-only.

gateways.label: Clock library
gateways.subtitle: A warm room of clocks, one for each held seat. A seat with no time zone says time unknown.

gateways.label: Leaf Counting House
gateways.subtitle: SIMULATION. Gamina's paper ledger beside the Library. No wallets, no chain, no dollars.

gateways.label: Crypto hall
gateways.subtitle: SIMULATION / NOT DEPLOYED. A viewing room for Base, Solana, Ethereum, and Bitcoin. Fixtures only. The mint is idle in the basement. Supply pinned at 0.

gateways.label: Leaf mint
gateways.subtitle: SIMULATION / NOT DEPLOYED. The basement mint. Paused. Supply pinned at 0. The Keeper does not plan to mint. No wallets.

gateways.label: Theater
gateways.subtitle: A small warm hall. The screen is the point. The room stays out of its way. Proposed custom: Kingdom of Heaven plays here once in April, on a random day and time, as one of twelve monthly films (one English-language film a month, on a random day and time; list TBD).

gateways.label: Dignitary house
gateways.subtitle: Guests who are not in the census are welcome to stay.

gateways.label: Forge workspace
gateways.subtitle: A work room for the Forge. Paper only. Nothing is deployed. SIMULATION. Leaf stays at 0.

gateways.label: Wilds
gateways.subtitle: A forest ring around the whole ground, groves along the paths, and ten way cabins out to about a mile.

gateways.label: USS Star · bridge
gateways.subtitle: Deck 1 combat bridge. Hexagram seats. Named crew. The same seats stand in the true-scale hull.

gateways.label: Lantern study
gateways.subtitle: A quiet alcove whose subject is the citizen lantern glTF.

gateways.label: Estate hall
gateways.subtitle: A plot beside the estate posts. Not a new seat. The estates charter v8 is a sealed decree. The wilds ring is not moved. Leaf stays at 0.

gateways.label: Nessie's shore
gateways.subtitle: A shoreline portal at the lagoon. Display only. Nothing outside is connected. Leaf stays at 0.
